honest_assessment: The from-scratch pipeline is verified end to end: correct next-token alignment, hand-derived gradients matching finite differences with non-unit layernorm scales, deterministic checkpoint reload, and resumable training. Held-out loss decreased. HOWEVER: this model is tiny (10,968 parameters, ~2.5 KB corpus) and its samples are NOT fluent English. It has not learned English in any meaningful sense; it has only learned coarse character statistics of a tiny corpus. A useful school assistant requires orders of magnitude more data and parameters, which this CPU-only environment cannot train.
